doc:
### PROPOSAL-09 — Cyberpunk Neo-Tokyo - **slug**: `cyberpunk` - **Vibe**: Holographic neon city at night — deep black-navy panels with electric magenta, cyan, and yellow, glitch accents, and hologram corners. - **Best for**: Posting Studio dashboard and real-time publish feed — automation that feels like a cyber deck. Adjectives: electric, futuristic, dense. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#060a14` | Deep black-navy city canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#0c1220` | Holo panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#141d33` | Raised holo panels, modals | | `--border-subtle` | `#1d2a45` | Fine circuit hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#2b3d63` | Standard neon borders | | `--border-focus` | `#00f0ff` | Electric-cyan focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#eef4ff` | High-contrast holo text | | `--text-secondary` | `#b7c3e0` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#6f7ea3` | Captions, timestamps, IDs | | `--color-action` | `#00f0ff` | Electric-cyan primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#00c8d6` | Action hover (deeper cyan) | | `--color-earnings` | `#ffe600` | Holographic-yellow earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#e6cf00` | Earnings hover (deeper yellow) | | `--color-automation` | `#ff2bd6` | Magenta automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#ffb000` | Amber warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#ff3b5c` | Neon-red failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25)` | Cyan aura behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(255, 230, 0, 0.20)` | Yellow aura behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(255, 43, 214, 0.25)` | Magenta aura behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Orbitron", "Rajdhani", sans-serif` at 700-900 — squared, techno, slightly wide; used for KPI numerals and section IDs. Sans: `"Rajdhani", "Exo 2", system-ui, sans-serif` at 500-700 with `letter-spacing: 0.02em`; uppercase micro-labels at 0.08em. Mono: `"Share Tech Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for log lines and hex-style IDs. Numerals `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Sharp hologram panels: 4px radius on panels, 2px on chips, pill buttons. Borders are 1px neon in `--border-default`; focus is a 2px cyan outline with a 2px gap. Signature panel corner: the top-left corner is clipped (via `clip-path`) like a cut holo-glass corner. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Dark fill with 1px neon border and glowing label; primary = cyan fill with near-black text (`#060a14`), hover runs a diagonal scan sweep. Secondary = transparent with magenta border. Focus = 2px `--border-focus` outline. - **Cards**: Holo-glass panels (dark translucent fill) with a 1px neon border, clipped corner, and a top-left `ACC-####` holo ID tag. Headers carry a thin cyan scan line. No soft shadows — glow only. - **Badges/Status**: Square chips with neon border and a square dot; publishing = blinking magenta square with RGB-split edge; published = cyan; failed = red. - **Tables**: Full 1px grid with neon column rules; header row mono uppercase; row hover = glitch-style double underline (red/cyan offset). - **Forms/Inputs**: Dark fields with a neon bottom rule; focus = cyan border + glow. Labels are uppercase Rajdhani. - **Loading**: A horizontal scanline sweeping the panel, or glitch "chunks" that pop in; determinate = segmented bar filling with RGB-split segments. - **Signature detail**: The glitch text effect — headings carry a 1px red/cyan RGB-split `text-shadow` — plus the clipped holo corner. Unmistakably Neo-Tokyo. - **Motion & Animation**: Glitchy and fast: 80-150ms with occasional two-frame horizontal displacement on entry; Turbo Stream inserts "glitch-in" (translateX 2px -> -2px -> 0). Hover scan sweeps; nothing floats. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
ACC-8821 // EARNINGS $12,480 +14.2% SYNCED
```
